player_prompt.intro:
You are solving the Sokoban puzzle. You are the player and you need to push all boxes to targets.
        When you are right next to a box, you can push it by moving in the same direction.
        You cannot push a box through a wall, and you cannot pull a box.
        On the board, objects are represented as: 
        - The player (you) appears as 'P' 
        - Walls are represented with '#' 
        - Boxes are marked as 'X' 
        - Empty goals are shown with a 'O'
        - Boxes on goals are visualized with '√'
        You can also use [w] for up, [a] for left, [s] for down, and [d] for right.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Likolo lya lilobaki lisa na fomu ya sika. Sonda [up], [down], [left], [right] to [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.not_valid_action: Likambo oyo otindaki ezali likambo ya malamu te.
invalid_move.invalid_position: Mobembo ya mabe - ekoki te kokende na esika wana.

game_message.pushed_prefix: atyaki na kati ya kɛsi moko ntango azalaki kosala yango.

outcome.win: Nazali kopesa yo longonya, osilisi likambo ya Sokoban!
outcome.turn_limit: Okokisi ndelo ya kobongwana na yo te. Osilisi likambo oyo ezali mpasi mpo ete moto ayeba yango malamu.
